summary.overview: The project has strong context routing, environment readiness, and quality gates with CI gating all changes and deployment gated on CI success. Session evidence is limited to one session with two edited episodes and no observed validation, which leaves Learning Capture unobserved and repeated-work detection unconfirmed.

dimensions.label: Task Understanding
dimensions.summary: AGENTS.md routes to PLAN.md and TASKS.md as canonical sources with six hard constraints and a clear Definition of Done, but no session evidence confirms the agent applied this boundary.

dimensions.label: Controlled Execution
dimensions.summary: Supported commands are visible in package.json and wired to CI, while permission boundaries are enforced through privacy constraints and least-privilege CI permissions.

dimensions.label: Change Validation
dimensions.summary: Test infrastructure covers 318 cases across 16 files wired to CI, but the session sample shows two edits with no observed validation command.

dimensions.label: Reliable Delivery
dimensions.summary: CI gates all pushes and PRs to master, deploy depends on CI success, and application-level recovery includes localStorage crash recovery and error boundaries, but no delivery decision was observed in the current session.

dimensions.label: Learning Capture
dimensions.summary: The bounded review found one session with two edited episodes but no validation, handoff, or outcome signals; the evidence boundary remains unobserved and cannot confirm lifecycle or repeated-work detection.
